description.value: Your resin contains a protective hardening reagent activated by stress. Whenever you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Clumsy], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Drained], or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Enfeebled], you gain resistance equal to the value of the condition against physical damage. This doesn't apply to conditions caused by beneficial effects, such as the enlarge spell.
